facts.claim: Mandvi Town had a population of 4,142 in 1901 and its municipality was established in 1868.
facts.quote: Population (1901), 4,142. The municipality was established in 1868.

facts.claim: The town’s income averaged Rs. 6,000 during the decade ending 1901 and was Rs. 6,273 in 1903-4.
facts.quote: During the decade ending 1901 the income averaged Rs. 6,000 ; in 1903-4 it was Rs. 6,273.

facts.claim: Mandvi Town had a dispensary and four schools, including an English school for boys, with 302 boys and 58 girls attending.
facts.quote: The town contains a dispensary and four schools, three (including an English school) for boys and one for girls, attended respectively by 302 and 58 pupils.
